description: Use this when the user wants to see one of their formulas: every line with material, bottle strength, amount, relative and absolute percent, flags and notes, plus totals, concentration, cost and the note pyramid. Optionally adds an IFRA Category 4 and EU allergen check of it ("is my formula IFRA compliant"). Can read a past version by number or id.

formula.description: The formula: its id (from list_formulas) or its exact name.

ifraConcentrationPct.description: How much of the finished product the formula is, for the IFRA check. Default: its target, else 20.

version.description: A version number such as "3", or its id. Omit for the working copy.

name: get_formula
title: Show one of your formulas
